proof.rowConnectivity: Each occupiedrow is one nonempty interval. Four-connectivity implies no missing occupiedrow and overlap of neighboringrowintervals; conversely the horizontal chains and sharedcolumn vertical edges connect everyrow chain into one component.
proof.necessityOfOneTurn: If left endpoints are not nonincreasing-then-nondecreasing, choose a thresholdcolumnc crossed upward inL then downward later. The row immediately before the upwardcrossing containsc because it overlaps the next interval whoseleft>c. The row immediately afterdownwardcrossing containsc because it overlaps the previousintervalwhoseleft>c. Inbetween a rowwithleft>c lacks c, violatingcolumncontiguity. Rightendpointcase is the reflected version.
proof.sufficiencyOfOneTurn: For a valleyL, the rows satisfyingL<=c form an interval; for a peakR, rows satisfyingR>=c form an interval. Their intersection gives exactlythe occupiedrows ofcolumnc, hence noholes. Togetherwithrowoverlap this is equivalent to the full geometry.
proof.uniquePhases: Leftflag0 means no strictL increase hasoccurred;0→1 iffnewL>oldl,1→1 requiresnewL>=oldl. Rightflag0→1 iffnewR<oldr;1→1requiresnewR<=oldr. Equalityneverstartsaphase, so each intervalhistory has oneflaghistory.

rectangleTransitions.invalidOldIntervals: All l>r states remain0. Halfopen empty rectangles yield0, including strict transitions atL0/RW-1.

proof.startEnd: Start exactlyone interval inphase00 pervalidgrassinterval. Onlypreviousrow transferred, so emptyrows cannot be skipped. Sum eachcurrentstate at its bottomrow exactlyonce. Emptyset hasno startinginterval and never counted.
proof.grassValidity: For each left, scanright untilfirstblockedcell andbreak;allandonlyfullyGintervals are considered, remainderstates zeroed.
proof.rolling: Prefix stores exactlythepreviousrow untilallnewstatescomplete;afterwards overwrite allprefix tables from the completecurrentrow. No mixed-row updates.

problemFeature.title: Balanced Subsets
features: 使用可能マスから非空の4近傍連結部分集合を選び、各行・各列の選択が途切れないものを数える。
長方形以外も許し、斜めだけの接触や空集合は除く。左右端の最初の厳密な内向き変化だけでphaseを切り替える。
原典N1..150のG/.正方形、答mod1000000007。掲載APIは縦横各0..150の長方形と空盤を拡張許容。
problemFeature.notes: 使用可能マスの非空4連結部分集合で、各行列の選択が一区間となるものを数える。行区間の隣接overlapとleft非増加→非減少/right非減少→非増加が必要十分。最初の厳密内向き変化だけを二flagへ記録し、前行の旧二端点に対する9個の長方形和で一意に遷移、全底行を足す。四枚の2Dprefixとrollingで原典N150をO(N^3)時間/O(N^2)空間で処理する。

integration.proseNormalization: Entry points use standard advanced/complexity/reasoning. Balanced prose uses Japanese flag/state/payload labels and explicitly gives O(A) zero-width validation; C++ unchanged.

rootReview.documentationAdjustmentBeforeIntegration: Empty-width extension validates A row lengths in O(A); add explicit O(1) empty-grid/O(A) zero-width cases before claiming O(AB+HW²) on positive dimensions. No code change needed.
proofReview: Row convexity makes each occupied row one interval.4-connectivity iff occupied rows are consecutive and adjacent intervals overlap.

A left endpoint increase followed later by decrease makes some column sublevel set disconnected. At both threshold crossings, adjacent interval overlap forces the right endpoint past that column, yielding an actual column hole. Right endpoint follows the reflected argument. Conversely valley L and hill R give interval sublevel/superlevel row sets whose intersection is each occupied column.
Flags record first STRICT inward move, preserving them on equality. Each actual interval sequence gets exactly one flag sequence, including all plateaus and already-inward equal steps.
Combine overlap l<=R and r>=L with each old→new flag condition to get exactly the printed left/right ranges. Old invalid l>r states stay0, so rectangular sums count no invalid interval.
The four implementation state formulas exactly sum all nine allowable old/new flag combinations. Strict0→1 bounds and weak1→1 bounds are correct at width1 and one-cell overlaps.

Only current all-G intervals get states; a blocked cell ends the inner extension. New one-row shapes start in00, previous row only prevents skipping empty rows, and accumulation across bottom rows counts every nonempty shape once.
apiReview: Validates outer size, first width, every row length and every character before empty shortcuts. Supports rectangular and zero-width extensions, fresh calls after exception, const input/no global caches.
If rows<cols, traverse original columns and use original rows as state width via grid[right][row]. Otherwise ordinary indexing. No copied transpose. Width=min(A,B),height=max(A,B).

Half-open rect indexes remain0..W and use size_t products. Every potentially negative prefix/rectangle sum and four-term transition sum starts widened to int64; normalized corrects negative modulo. Answer also widened before add.

DP buffers cleared each row and prefix rebuilt only after all current states, so no mixing old/new rows. Eight arrays total4W²+4(W+1)² ints=724816bytes atW150, plus fixed vector metadata. No recursion.
Positive dimensions O(AB+HW²)time/O(W²)extra space; original squareN<=150 isO(N³)/O(N²). Empty cases documented separately before integration.
